title: Work-tape register position
statement: Let $c_0$ be a configuration with $m$ work tapes, let a call specification select an ordered list of registers, let $W$ assign a bit string to each register, and let $s$ and $t$ be a segment index and track position. For register $r$, its position is the position in $c_0$ if $r$ is not selected. If it is selected, write $j$ for its index in the selected list plus one: its position is the length of segment $j$ when $j<s$, is $-1$ when $s<j$, and is the track position at segment $s$ when $s=j$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration c₀ with m work tapes and input x
A call specification with m registers
A register r among the m registers
caveat: The snippet does not provide the definitions of segment length or track position, so their precise conventions cannot be stated here.
